summary: Verified /tickets page layout redesign: poster left / purchase panel right on desktop, stacked on mobile, checkout modal + SIM redirect regression all pass.

test_results.desktop_layout: PASS — poster bbox x=64..512, GA card bbox x=1029..1815 (poster clearly left of purchase panel).
test_results.right_panel_content: PASS — 'Get Your Ticket' heading, EARLY BIRD card with ga-price=449 Kč, 'Most Popular' badge, next-release='Next release: 499 Kč', price-progression strip present, orange Buy Ticket button.
test_results.vip_card: PASS — VIP card (vip-price=799 Kč) renders below GA in same right column (x=1021, y=825 vs GA y=365).
test_results.checkout_modal: PASS — clicking Buy Ticket opens checkout-modal with name/email/quantity fields and 'Continue to Payment — 449 Kč' button. Close button dismisses modal.
test_results.mobile_390x844: PASS — poster (y=112) stacks above GA card (y=838), scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow), buy button visible.
test_results.regression_sim_redirect: PASS — submitting checkout form redirected to /pay/2d65154bf08a4149aba6e2e36aa0b970 (SIM). Payment not completed as instructed.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: Console shows a React 'span cannot be a child of option' hydration warning inside CheckoutModal's quantity <select>. Source code in Tickets.js line 87 is clean ({i+1} ticket{i>0?'s':''}); the warning comes from Emergent's dev-tool DOM instrumentation injecting <span> wrappers into <option>. Only appears in preview/dev; no user-visible impact. Safe to ignore unless it reproduces in a production build.
test_credentials: LOCKDOWN_PASSWORD read from backend/.env; bypassed via localStorage atf_unlocked='1'.
seed_data_creation: One TEST order created via SIM checkout (name='TEST User', email='test@example.com'); payment not completed so order stays in pending state.
